## AI Agent Directory
> Top 150 ranked plugins and MCP servers for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.

### Hub
- [Agent Directory](/agents): Browse OpenClaw plugins, MCP servers, and Hermes plugins
- [Agentic Dev Hub](/agentic): Rankings, comparisons, MCPs, and jobs for agentic developers
- [OpenClaw Plugins](/openclaw/plugins): Top 50 native OpenClaw extensions
- [MCP Servers](/openclaw/mcps): Top 50 Model Context Protocol servers
- [Hermes Plugins](/hermes/plugins): Top 50 Hermes Agent plugins
- [Cursor Rules](/cursor-rules): Curated .cursorrules for AI coding agents
- [List an MCP](/post-mcp): Feature your MCP server — $199/mo

### Top OpenClaw Plugins
- [Discord](/openclaw/plugins/discord): Connect OpenClaw to Discord as a messaging channel with full tool access.
- [Slack](/openclaw/plugins/slack): Slack workspace integration for OpenClaw agents.
- [Telegram](/openclaw/plugins/telegram): Telegram bot channel for OpenClaw with DM and group support.
- [WhatsApp](/openclaw/plugins/whatsapp): WhatsApp messaging channel for OpenClaw agents.
- [Signal](/openclaw/plugins/signal): Signal messenger integration for privacy-focused agent chat.
- [Matrix](/openclaw/plugins/matrix): Decentralized Matrix protocol channel for OpenClaw.
- [Microsoft Teams](/openclaw/plugins/teams-meetings): Microsoft Teams messaging and meetings integration.
- [iMessage](/openclaw/plugins/imessage): Apple iMessage channel for macOS OpenClaw deployments.
- [Google Chat](/openclaw/plugins/googlechat): Google Chat workspace integration for OpenClaw.
- [Feishu / Lark](/openclaw/plugins/feishu): Feishu/Lark enterprise messaging channel.

### Top MCP Servers
- [Filesystem](/openclaw/mcps/filesystem): Secure local file read/write with configurable directory access.
- [Memory](/openclaw/mcps/memory): Knowledge graph memory server for persistent agent recall.
- [GitHub](/openclaw/mcps/github): Repository management, issues, PRs, and code search via GitHub API.
- [GitLab](/openclaw/mcps/gitlab): GitLab project and merge request management.
- [PostgreSQL](/openclaw/mcps/postgres): Read-only SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases.
- [SQLite](/openclaw/mcps/sqlite): Query and analyze local SQLite database files.
- [Fetch](/openclaw/mcps/fetch): Fetch and convert web page content for LLM consumption.
- [Playwright](/openclaw/mcps/playwright): Full browser automation with Playwright for web tasks.
- [Puppeteer](/openclaw/mcps/puppeteer): Headless Chrome automation via Puppeteer MCP server.
- [Brave Search](/openclaw/mcps/brave-search): Web and local search via Brave Search API.

### Top Hermes Plugins
- [Firecrawl](/hermes/plugins/firecrawl): Default web search backend with excellent speed and result quality.
- [OpenRouter](/hermes/plugins/openrouter): Gateway to 200+ models from every major provider.
- [Tavily](/hermes/plugins/tavily): AI-optimized web search tailored for agent use cases.
- [Langfuse](/hermes/plugins/langfuse): Full observability — traces conversations, LLM calls, and tool usage.
- [Ollama (Local)](/hermes/plugins/ollama): Run Llama, Mistral, Phi-3 locally with zero API cost.
- [OpenAI Image Gen](/hermes/plugins/openai-image-gen): OpenAI gpt-image-2 generation with best available quality.
- [Spotify](/hermes/plugins/spotify): Full playback control — devices, queue, search, playlists.
- [Google Meet](/hermes/plugins/google-meet): Join calls, transcribe captions, and speak in realtime.
- [Kanban](/hermes/plugins/kanban): Multi-profile work queue and orchestration board.
- [Mem0](/hermes/plugins/mem0): Server-side LLM fact extraction with semantic search.
## AI Coding Agents
> Ranked comparisons of AI coding agents for agentic developers.

### Hub
- [Best AI Coding Agents (2026)](/compare/ai-coding-agents): Ranked hub with token usage and head-to-head links

### Top Agents
- [Hermes Agent](/compare/hermes-agent): Open-source, self-improving AI agent with persistent memory and 40+ built-in tools.
- [Kilo Code](/compare/kilo-code): Open-source AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI.
- [Cline](/compare/cline): Open-source AI coding agent inside your IDE with browser automation.
- [Claude Code](/compare/claude-code): Anthropic's agentic coding tool for planning and executing across your codebase.
- [OpenClaw](/compare/openclaw): Open-source AI agent connected to messaging apps for real-world actions.
- [pi](/compare/pi): There are many coding agents, but this one is yours.
- [Codebuff](/compare/codebuff): Self-improving CLI agent.
- [Codex](/compare/codex): OpenAI coding agent to help you build and ship with AI.
- [Cursor](/compare/cursor): The AI-native code editor used by millions of developers.
- [Windsurf](/compare/windsurf): Agentic IDE by Codeium with Cascade flows.
